description: Public addresses the Atropyle team controls, per chain. Each entry has a role and a source anyone can check. The traction counters (SDK counters(), the web app, npm run daily:check) count a vault as a team vault when its owner is listed here, so every team wallet that could own a vault belongs in this list. To add a wallet, append an entry to the chain's members with one of the roles below and a public source (a transaction, a contract view or a deployment record). scripts/deployments-sync.ts copies the addresses and roles into packages/sdk/src/deployments/team.ts.

roles.treasury: Receives every vault creation fee: AtropyleFactory.treasury(), fixed at construction.
roles.keeper: Signs the permissionless poke and distribute calls of the backend keeper.
